_readme: Real localities pulled from the live Locality collection; prices are rough web-searched locality rates (demo values, not appraisals).
Replace every REPLACE_WITH_CLOUDINARY_URL_* with a real uploaded Cloudinary URL before importing.
Every imported listing is set isSeed=true, status=approved, seedExpiresAt=+30 days, dealerId=null.
